with usage_window as materialized (
      select
        b.agent_id as agent_id,
        d.accepted_at as accepted_at,
        d.turn_report ->> 'outcome' = 'failed' as failed,
        case when d.execution_origin = 'cloud' then null else d.turn_report #>> '{usage,inputTokens}' end as input_text,
        case when d.execution_origin = 'cloud' then null else d.turn_report #>> '{usage,cachedInputTokens}' end as cached_text,
        case when d.execution_origin = 'cloud' then null else d.turn_report #>> '{usage,outputTokens}' end as output_text
      from im_message_deliveries d
      inner join sessions s on s.id = d.session_id
      inner join im_bindings b on b.id = s.im_binding_id
      where b.agent_id in ($1::uuid)
    and d.accepted_at >= $2::timestamptz
    and d.accepted_at <= $3::timestamptz
    ),
    flagged_window as materialized (
      select
        *,
        ((case when input_text ~ '^[0-9]+$' then input_text::numeric <= $4 when input_text is null then true else false end) and (case when cached_text ~ '^[0-9]+$' then cached_text::numeric <= $5 when cached_text is null then true else false end) and (case when output_text ~ '^[0-9]+$' then output_text::numeric <= $6 when output_text is null then true else false end)) as canonical
      from usage_window
    )
  
    select
      agent_id as "agentId",
      count(*)::text as "tasks",
      count(*) filter (where failed)::text as "failed",
      coalesce(sum(case when input_text ~ '^[0-9]+$' then input_text::numeric else 0 end), 0)::text as "inputTokens",
      coalesce(sum(case when cached_text ~ '^[0-9]+$' then cached_text::numeric else 0 end), 0)::text as "cachedInputTokens",
      coalesce(sum(case when output_text ~ '^[0-9]+$' then output_text::numeric else 0 end), 0)::text as "outputTokens",
      bool_or(case when input_text is null then false
      when input_text ~ '^[0-9]+$' then input_text::numeric > $7
      else true end or case when cached_text is null then false
      when cached_text ~ '^[0-9]+$' then cached_text::numeric > $8
      else true end or case when output_text is null then false
      when output_text ~ '^[0-9]+$' then output_text::numeric > $9
      else true end)
        as "invalidTokenCount"
    from flagged_window
    group by agent_id

Plans.Filter: ((accepted_at >= '2026-09-26 08:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (accepted_at <= '2026-10-26 08:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone))

      select

        case when d.execution_origin = 'cloud' then null else d.turn_report #>> '{usage,cachedInputTokens}' end as cached_text,
        case when d.execution_origin = 'cloud' then null else d.turn_report #>> '{usage,outputTokens}' end as output_text
      from im_message_deliveries d
      inner join sessions s on s.id = d.session_id
      inner join im_bindings b on b.id = s.im_binding_id
      where b.agent_id = $1::uuid
    and d.accepted_at >= $2::timestamptz
    and d.accepted_at <= $3::timestamptz
    ),
    flagged_window as materialized (
      select
        *,
        ((case when input_text ~ '^[0-9]+$' then input_text::numeric <= $4 when input_text is null then true else false end) and (case when cached_text ~ '^[0-9]+$' then cached_text::numeric <= $5 when cached_text is null then true else false end) and (case when output_text ~ '^[0-9]+$' then output_text::numeric <= $6 when output_text is null then true else false end)) as canonical
      from usage_window
    )
  
    select
      to_char(accepted_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "day",
      count(*)::text as "tasks",
      count(*) filter (where failed)::text as "failed",
      count(*) filter (where canonical
        and (input_text is not null or cached_text is not null or output_text is not null))::text as "measuredTasks",
      count(*) filter (where not canonical)::text as "approximatedTasks",
      coalesce(sum(case when canonical then coalesce(input_text::numeric, 0) else 0 end), 0)::text as "inputTokens",
      coalesce(sum(case when canonical then coalesce(cached_text::numeric, 0) else 0 end), 0)::text as "cachedInputTokens",
      coalesce(sum(case when canonical then coalesce(output_text::numeric, 0) else 0 end), 0)::text as "outputTokens"
    from flagged_window
    group by 1

select
        link.descendant_session_id as "sessionId",
        child.created_by_session_id as "parentSessionId",
        child.created_at as "createdAt",
        link.last_message_created_at as "lastMessageAt",
        link.last_message_id as "lastMessageId",
        link.last_delivery_outcome as "lastDeliveryOutcome",
        link.task_preview as "taskPreview"
      from session_descendants link
      inner join sessions child on child.id = link.descendant_session_id
      where link.ancestor_session_id = $1::uuid
        and link.descendant_active
        -- An older binary ends a Session without maintaining the closure flag. The derived predicate
        -- keeps that row out of the page and bounds the extra work to the drift, not to the history.
        and child.ended_at is null
        
        
        
      order by link.last_message_created_at desc, link.last_message_id desc, link.descendant_session_id desc
      limit $2
